title: 高速鐵路路線平縱面設計~Horizontal and vertical alignment for high-speed rail
focus: 平縱曲線連續性與高速動態舒適性~Alignment continuity and high-speed dynamic comfort
summary: 高速鐵路路線平縱面設計以「平縱曲線連續性與高速動態舒適性」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。路線設計先建立平面與高程共同里程，再檢查曲率、坡度和變化率；地形可行的中心線仍可能因高速動態需求而需要更長緩和段。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops alignment continuity and high-speed dynamic comfort through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Alignment design uses a shared chainage for plan and elevation before checking curvature, gradient and their rates; a terrain-feasible centreline may still require longer transitions for high-speed dynamics. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把高速鐵路路線平縱面設計放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。路線設計先建立平面與高程共同里程，再檢查曲率、坡度和變化率；地形可行的中心線仍可能因高速動態需求而需要更長緩和段。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Horizontal and vertical alignment for high-speed rail in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Alignment design uses a shared chainage for plan and elevation before checking curvature, gradient and their rates; a terrain-feasible centreline may still require longer transitions for high-speed dynamics. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=80 m/s, R=6400 m；y=v**2/R=1 m/s2。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=1.21 m/s2。模型邊界：等速圓周運動且半徑固定，不含超高補償；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：L=20 m, R=5000 m；y=L**2/(8*R)*1000=10 mm。只把 L 增加百分之十，y=12.1 mm。模型邊界：弦長遠小於半徑的小弦近似；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=80 m/s, R=6400 m; y=v**2/R=1 m/s2. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.21 m/s2. Boundary: Uniform circular motion at fixed radius, without cant compensation; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: L=20 m, R=5000 m; y=L**2/(8*R)*1000=10 mm. Increasing only L with a ten-percent increase gives y=12.1 mm. Boundary: Short-chord approximation with chord length much smaller than radius; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.title: 圓曲線向心加速~Circular-curve acceleration
units.mechanism: 向心加速度隨速度平方增加並隨半徑增加而降低。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.21 m/s2。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。等速圓周運動且半徑固定，不含超高補償。使用同里程速度及曲率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略速度變動會把幾何問題誤判為懸吊問題，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Centripetal acceleration increases with speed squared and decreases with radius. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1.21 m/s2. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform circular motion at fixed radius, without cant compensation. Use speed and curvature at matching chainage as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Ignoring speed variation can misidentify a geometry problem as suspension failure; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=80 m/s, R=6400 m；y=v**2/R=1 m/s2。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=1.21 m/s2。模型邊界：等速圓周運動且半徑固定，不含超高補償；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=80 m/s, R=6400 m; y=v**2/R=1 m/s2. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.21 m/s2. Boundary: Uniform circular motion at fixed radius, without cant compensation; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以同里程速度及曲率區分模型與觀察，先用合成速度計與路線曲率資料建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「圓曲線向心加速」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use speed and curvature at matching chainage to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic speed sensor and alignment curvature data, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Circular-curve acceleration. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 忽略速度變動會把幾何問題誤判為懸吊問題。這個失效與「圓曲線向心加速」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查同里程速度及曲率，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Ignoring speed variation can misidentify a geometry problem as suspension failure. This failure and a measurement bias in Circular-curve acceleration can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check speed and curvature at matching chainage rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略速度變動會把幾何問題誤判為懸吊問題~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring speed variation can misidentify a geometry problem as suspension failure.
units.practice: 重算「圓曲線向心加速」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出等速圓周運動且半徑固定，不含超高補償如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由忽略速度變動會把幾何問題誤判為懸吊問題造成偏離的合成觀察，以同里程速度及曲率說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Circular-curve acceleration, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Uniform circular motion at fixed radius, without cant compensation. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Ignoring speed variation can misidentify a geometry problem as suspension failure. Explain which evidence in speed and curvature at matching chainage distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 曲線外矢估算~Curve versine estimate
units.title: 曲線外矢估算~Curve versine estimate
units.mechanism: 小弦長近似下外矢與弦長平方成正比，弦長改變時不能直接比較讀值。本模型把 L 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 12.1 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。弦長遠小於半徑的小弦近似。使用已知弦長的中點偏距作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把不同弦長外矢當同一幾何量會誤判曲率，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~For a short chord the versine scales with chord length squared; different chord lengths cannot be compared directly. In this model, L is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 12.1 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Short-chord approximation with chord length much smaller than radius. Use midpoint offset for a known chord length as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Comparing versines from different chords misidentifies curvature; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

Increasing only L with a ten-percent increase gives y=12.1 mm. Boundary: Short-chord approximation with chord length much smaller than radius; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以已知弦長的中點偏距區分模型與觀察，先用固定弦長直尺與中點偏距計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「曲線外矢估算」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use midpoint offset for a known chord length to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. units.failure: 把不同弦長外矢當同一幾何量會誤判曲率。這個失效與「曲線外矢估算」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查已知弦長的中點偏距，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Comparing versines from different chords misidentifies curvature. units.anchor: 緩和曲線曲率率~Transition curvature rate
units.title: 緩和曲線曲率率~Transition curvature rate
units.mechanism: 克羅梭曲線讓曲率沿里程線性增長，並不代表橫向加速度在變速時仍線性。本模型把 R 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 6.31313e-07 1/m2。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。曲率沿緩和長度線性變化。使用曲率對里程的斜率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；緩和段縮短會提高曲率變化率，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~A clothoid increases curvature linearly with distance, but lateral acceleration need not remain linear when speed changes. In this model, R is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output decreases to 6.31313e-07 1/m2. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Curvature varies linearly along transition length. Use curvature slope against chainage as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Shortening the transition increases curvature rate; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：R=6000 m, L=240 m；y=1/(R*L)=6.94444e-07 1/m2。只把 R 增加百分之十，y=6.31313e-07 1/m2。模型邊界：曲率沿緩和長度線性變化；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: R=6000 m, L=240 m; y=1/(R*L)=6.94444e-07 1/m2. Increasing only R with a ten-percent increase gives y=6.31313e-07 1/m2. Boundary: Curvature varies linearly along transition length; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以曲率對里程的斜率區分模型與觀察，先用共同里程的曲率樣本與基線建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「緩和曲線曲率率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use curvature slope against chainage to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using curvature samples and baseline on common chainage, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Transition curvature rate. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 緩和段縮短會提高曲率變化率。這個失效與「緩和曲線曲率率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查曲率對里程的斜率，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Shortening the transition increases curvature rate. units.anchor: 橫向加加速度~Lateral jerk estimate
units.title: 橫向加加速度~Lateral jerk estimate
units.mechanism: 固定速度時幾何橫向加加速度含速度三次方，不能以速度比例直接外推。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.473244 m/s3。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。克羅梭曲線與固定速度，不含超高或車體滾動。使用固定速率曲率變化與橫向加速度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只檢查圓曲線半徑會漏掉進出曲線的不平順，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~At fixed speed the geometric lateral jerk contains speed cubed, so linear speed scaling is incorrect. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.473244 m/s3. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Clothoid at constant speed, excluding cant and body roll. Use curvature change and lateral acceleration at steady speed as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Checking circular radius alone misses transition discomfort; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

units.failure: 把定位偏移當沉陷會引發錯誤修正。這個失效與「里程誤差投影」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查同基準的里程和高程殘差，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Mistaking position shift for settlement leads to incorrect correction. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

units.title: 設計容差合成~Alignment uncertainty combination
units.mechanism: 獨立正交誤差可按平方和合成，共同系統偏差則不能如此抵消。本模型把 ux 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2.07422 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。兩個零均值獨立正交誤差，不含共同偏差。使用重複測站與獨立閉合差作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把相關誤差當獨立誤差會低估不確定度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Independent orthogonal errors combine by root-sum-square, but shared systematic biases do not cancel this way. In this model, ux is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 2.07422 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Two zero-mean independent orthogonal errors, excluding shared bias. Use repeat stations and independent closure errors as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Treating correlated errors as independent understates uncertainty; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：ux=1.2 mm, uy=1.6 mm；y=sqrt(ux**2+uy**2)=2 mm。只把 ux 增加百分之十，y=2.07422 mm。模型邊界：兩個零均值獨立正交誤差，不含共同偏差；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: ux=1.2 mm, uy=1.6 mm; y=sqrt(ux**2+uy**2)=2 mm. Increasing only ux with a ten-percent increase gives y=2.07422 mm. Boundary: Two zero-mean independent orthogonal errors, excluding shared bias; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以重複測站與獨立閉合差區分模型與觀察，先用獨立控制網閉合觀測建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「設計容差合成」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use repeat stations and independent closure errors to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using independent survey-network closure observations, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Alignment uncertainty combination. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

This failure and a measurement bias in Alignment uncertainty combination can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check repeat stations and independent closure errors rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
